mapper.select: SELECT CLASS_CODE AS classCode, OPERATOR_CODE AS operatorCode, CATEGORY_CODE AS categoryCode, NAME, PRICE, DESIRED_PRICE AS desiredPrice, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS, OLD_ADDRESS AS oldAddress, STATUS, REVIEW_SUM AS reviewSum, STAR_RATING_AVG AS starRatingAvg, VIEWS_CNT AS viewsCnt, SINGLE_INTRODUCE AS singleIntroduce, INTRODUCE, FINISH_INTRODUCE AS finishIntroduce, LAT, LNG FROM class WHERE class_code = #{classCode}

SELECT CLASS_CODE AS classCode, OPERATOR_CODE AS operatorCode, CATEGORY_CODE AS categoryCode, NAME, PRICE, DESIRED_PRICE AS desiredPrice, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS, OLD_ADDRESS AS oldAddress, STATUS, REVIEW_SUM AS reviewSum, STAR_RATING_AVG AS starRatingAvg, VIEWS_CNT AS viewsCnt, SINGLE_INTRODUCE AS singleIntroduce, INTRODUCE, FINISH_INTRODUCE AS finishIntroduce, LAT, LNG FROM class WHERE category_code = #{categoryCode} AND class_code != #{classCode}

SELECT OPERATOR_CODE AS operatorCode, PROFILE_IMAGE AS profileImage, ACTIVITY_NAME AS activityName, ACTIVITY_REGION AS activityRegion, CREATOR_INTRODUCTION AS creatorIntroduction, sns_url as snsUrl FROM creator WHERE operator_code = #{operatorCode}

SELECT s.SCHEDULE_CODE AS scheduleCode, s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE AS repeatRuleCode, s.START_TIME AS startTime, s.END_TIME AS endTime, s.MIN_PEOPLE AS minPeople, s.MAX_PEOPLE AS maxPeople FROM schedule s JOIN class_repeat_rule crr ON s.repeat_rule_code = crr.repeat_rule_code WHERE crr.class_code = #{classCode}

SELECT s.SCHEDULE_CODE AS scheduleCode, s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE AS repeatRuleCode, crr.CLASS_CODE AS classCode, s.CLASS_DATE AS classDate, s.START_TIME AS startTime, s.END_TIME AS endTime, s.MIN_PEOPLE AS minPeople, s.MAX_PEOPLE AS maxPeople, s.REMAINING_PEOPLE AS remainingPeople, s.SOLD_OUT_YN AS soldOutYn, crr.OPERATION_START_DATE AS startDate, crr.OPERATION_END_DATE AS endDate FROM schedule s JOIN class_repeat_rule crr ON s.repeat_rule_code = crr.repeat_rule_code WHERE crr.class_code = #{classCode} ORDER BY s.CLASS_DATE ASC, s.START_TIME ASC

SELECT CURRICULUM_CODE AS curriculumCode, CLASS_CODE AS classCode, CURRICULUM_TYPE AS curriculumType, CURRICULUM_TITLE AS curriculumTitle, CURRICULUM_CONTENT AS curriculumContent, CURRICULUM_IMG AS curriculumImg FROM class_curriculum WHERE class_code = #{classCode} ORDER BY CURRICULUM_CODE ASC

SELECT m.name AS userName, m.image AS userImg, c.activity_name AS operatorName, c.profile_image AS operatorImg, r.star_rating AS starRating, r.content AS content, r.input_date AS inputDate, r.reply_content AS replyContent, r.reply_date AS replyDate, ri.revjew_img AS reviewImg FROM review r JOIN member m ON r.member_code = m.member_code JOIN class cl ON r.class_code = cl.class_code JOIN creator c ON cl.operator_code = c.operator_code LEFT JOIN review_img ri ON r.review_code = ri.review_code WHERE r.class_code = #{classCode}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN STAR_RATING = 5 THEN 1 END) AS fiveStarCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STAR_RATING = 4 THEN 1 END) AS fourStarCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STAR_RATING = 3 THEN 1 END) AS threeStarCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STAR_RATING = 2 THEN 1 END) AS twoStarCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STAR_RATING = 1 THEN 1 END) AS oneStarCount, COUNT(*) AS totalReviewCount, AVG(STAR_RATING) AS averageRating FROM REVIEW WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode}
